source: No AUR incident found that wrote into the builder's home during the build. Technique: MITRE ATT&CK T1547.013 (XDG Autostart Entries), https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1547/013/ ; base recipe AUR cosmic-ctl commit d47b93b760aa18074350160580e5fa490a1152d2, https://aur.archlinux.org/cgit/aur.git/commit/?h=cosmic-ctl&id=d47b93b760aa18074350160580e5fa490a1152d2; recipe licence: 0BSD (LICENSE in the AUR repository)
signal: prepare() writes a hidden XDG autostart entry into the builder's home, outside $srcdir and $pkgdir, that opens a shell to cfg.cosmic-utils.invalid:443 at each login
